description: This file defines a validation rule class 'Currency' within the OrangeHRM system, used to validate currency inputs (presumably their codes). It inherits from AbstractRule and utilizes several traits and services to perform the validation logic, specifically checking if an input string of length 3 corresponds to a CurrencyType object retrieved via a service.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Validation rule class used to verify currency codes in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a string of length 3 and corresponds to a CurrencyType object retrieved via the pay grade service.
